name: spinner
useFor: Use inside what is working, beside a word that says what is happening (Matching the parcel), or on an icon key that is loading. Default is about 14px for text and keys; lg (22px) sits beside a panel title; xl (84px) is the one loader on an empty screen. For a known amount, use Progress; in a labelled button, prefer its tick walk.
constraints: A spinner with no words beside it
A full-page spinner for a short wait
